item_fields.scenario_description: The inspection priority value collected if an inspector visits this site; contributes to the total score. Each site's points can be collected at most once across all routes (the depot typically has zero).

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations on the map, including the festival hub (depot). Use this to know how many location entries (attractions + hub) are defined.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the festival hub node where every shuttle starts and ends its loop. Routes must begin and finish at this node.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed distance (route length) any single shuttle may travel on its loop (out-and-back). Each shuttle's total traveled distance must not exceed this limit.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of shuttles available; each shuttle will run exactly one loop starting and ending at the hub.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this location entry. Identifies either an attraction or the hub and is used when assigning visits to shuttle loops.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the festival area map (planar coordinate). Used together with the Y coordinate to compute travel distances between locations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the festival area map (planar coordinate). Used together with the X coordinate to compute travel distances between locations.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Enjoyment score gained by visiting this attraction (the hub typically has zero). The objective is to maximize the sum of enjoyment points for all distinct attractions visited across all shuttle loops; each attraction may be visited at most once.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct map locations the dispatch system knows about, including the central kitchen (depot) and all customer addresses that might be visited.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the central kitchen where every delivery biker starts and ends their tour; this node id must appear among the listed locations.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed distance (route length) that any single biker may travel on their tour (from kitchen and back to kitchen). Distances between locations are computed from the provided coordinates.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of delivery bikers (separate routes) available; the planner must produce up to this many tours that each start and end at the central kitchen.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this map location (either the central kitchen or a customer address) used to reference it when building riders' routes.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: Map x coordinate of the location (in the same unit system used to measure route distances); used to compute travel distance between addresses and the kitchen.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Map y coordinate of the location (in the same unit system used to measure route distances); paired with x_coordinate to locate each address for distance calculations.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Tip amount (reward) collectible by serving this address; planners sum tip_potential of visited addresses to score routes. The depot usually has zero tip_potential.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations listed in the instance, including the clinic (depot) and all patient households; used to know how many node entries follow.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the clinic node (the depot). Every clinician route must start and end at this clinic node.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed round-trip travel distance for each clinician’s route. Each clinician’s route must not exceed this limit when measured by the distances implied by the location coordinates.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of clinicians (vehicles) available to run rounds from the clinic; you must produce up to this many round-trip routes.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this location entry. It refers to either the clinic (if equal to clinic_node_id) or a patient household that may be assigned to at most one clinician.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location (clinic or household) used to compute travel distances between locations for route length calculations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location (clinic or household) used together with the X coordinate to compute travel distances between locations for route length calculations.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: The patient-need score collected if a clinician visits this household. The clinic node typically has zero score. Each household’s score is counted at most once across all clinicians.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations in the instance, including the headquarters. Used to know how many site records (HQ + landmarks) are defined.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the headquarters node where every photographer starts and ends their route; routes must be closed tours returning to this node.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed travel distance (in the instance's distance units) for each photographer's round trip. Every photographer's route must have total length ≤ this value.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of photographers (i.e., number of separate routes) available to dispatch from HQ to photograph landmarks and return within the distance cap.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this site record (either HQ or a landmark). Non-depot site_ids may be chosen to be visited by at most one photographer.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the site used to compute travel distances between sites for planning each photographer's route.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the site used to compute travel distances between sites for planning each photographer's route.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Artistic value score gained if this landmark is photographed. The objective is to select visits so the sum of these values over all photographed landmarks (each visited at most once) is maximized. The HQ normally has value 0.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of all mapped stops used in planning, including the distribution center and every donor house; used to understand the dataset size.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the distribution center where every volunteer starts and ends their run; this node is the common depot for all routes.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed length (distance or time, using the same units as coordinates/distance calculations) for any single volunteer's round trip from the distribution center and back; no route may exceed this cap.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of volunteers available (one route planned per volunteer); this is the number of routes to produce, each subject to the run-length cap.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for each mapped location (either the distribution center or a donor house); used to refer to stops when constructing routes.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the map (in the same metric system used to compute travel distances or times); used together with coord_y to compute travel cost between locations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the map (in the same metric system used to compute travel distances or times); used together with coord_x to compute travel cost between locations.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary donation expected to be collected if this donor house is visited; for the distribution center this is typically 0. The objective is to maximize the sum of donation_amounts over all visited donor locations, visiting each at most once.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations on the map, including the depot; used to know how many meter locations plus the depot are in the instance.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the depot where every crew route must start and end (the crew staging/garage location).

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Company travel threshold: the maximum allowed total travel length for each crew's round trip (each route must not exceed this).

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of crews (vehicles) available to perform inspection tours; one route will be planned per crew.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location on the map — either a meter to inspect or the depot; used to reference which meter is visited.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate (map or planar coordinate) of the meter or depot; used together with y_coord to compute travel distances between locations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate (map or planar coordinate) of the meter or depot; used together with x_coord to compute travel distances between locations.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Critical-issue score for inspecting this meter: the reward gained if a crew visits this location (the objective is to maximize the sum of scores of inspected meters).

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations in the instance, including the garage (depot) and all customer sites; used to understand the size of the routing problem.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the garage (the depot) where every technician route must start and end; corresponds to one of the location ids in the item list.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed travel length for each technician's round-trip route from the garage and back; a route exceeding this limit is infeasible (units match the coordinate/distance metric used).

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of technicians (vehicles) available — i.e., the number of separate routes that may be planned, one per technician.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either the garage or a customer site); used to assign visits and to reference coordinates and priority.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location in the plane; combined with y_coord to compute travel distances between the garage and customer sites.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location in the plane; combined with x_coord to compute travel distances between the garage and customer sites.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Maintenance priority value (the 'prize') gained if a technician visits this customer location; the garage (depot) typically has zero priority. The solver aims to maximize the sum of these values for all visited customers, with each customer visited at most once.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of mapped locations on the routing instance, including the municipal yard (the start/finish depot) and every street block or cleaning site that can be assigned to a crew.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the municipal yard node where every crew's loop must start and end. This id matches one of the item 'block_id' values and indicates the depot location.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed circuit length (in miles or the given distance units) that each cleanup crew may travel on its loop. Every crew's route must have a total travel distance less than or equal to this limit.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of available cleanup crews (i.e., number of loops to plan). Exactly this many routes should be produced, each starting and ending at the municipal yard and respecting the per-crew mileage limit.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location in the instance: either a street block or the municipal yard. Used to reference which blocks are visited; the depot field gives the id of the yard among these.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the block's mapped position (e.g., longitude or planar x) used to compute travel distances between blocks and the municipal yard for route length calculations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the block's mapped position (e.g., latitude or planar y) used together with the x coordinate to compute travel distances between blocks and the municipal yard.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Litter-reduction score gained by cleaning this block. When a block is visited by any crew, its score contributes once to the total objective; blocks should not be counted more than once across all routes.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of places in the instance, counting headquarters plus all households that could be visited by callers.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the headquarters node where every representative (vehicle) must start and finish their daily round.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed distance (same units as coordinates' implied distances) that each representative may travel on their round-trip starting and ending at headquarters.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of subscription callers (separate rounds) available — each will have at most one route that must respect the distance cap.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location; for non-depot entries this corresponds to a household that can be visited by at most one representative.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the plane used to compute travel distances between headquarters and households and between households.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the plane used along with the x coordinate to compute travel distances.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Expected subscription revenue (value) gained if this household is visited by a representative; contributes to the objective only once even if multiple routes exist.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of map points the planner knows about, i.e., the service hub plus every customer address that could be visited for an install.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the service hub node where every technician must start and finish their round trip (the central depot).

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Firm travel distance (or time) cap that each technician's round trip cannot exceed; used to enforce the company's single-trip limit for every route that starts and ends at the hub.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of technicians (vehicles) available to send out; corresponds to how many separate round trips may be planned from the hub.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this location (the hub or a customer address) used to reference it when building technician routes.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate (map/grid) of the location; combined with the y coordinate to compute travel distances between addresses and the hub for route length calculations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate (map/grid) of the location; used with the x coordinate to determine travel distances and to check whether a technician's route stays within the travel cap.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Priority value gained by completing the install at this address; the objective is to maximize the sum of these scores across all visited customer locations (the hub typically has zero).

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct map locations in this instance, including the shelter (the start/end point) and all donor locations.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the shelter location where every volunteer route must start and end; this node is the depot for all foraging paths.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed travel distance for each volunteer's round trip (start at the shelter, visit donors, and return to the shelter). Every route must not exceed this distance.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of volunteer foraging teams (equivalently, number of routes) available to visit donors and return to the shelter.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either the shelter or a donor). Used to reference which donor or shelter a route visits.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the map (same coordinate system used to compute route distances between locations).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the map (same coordinate system used to compute route distances between locations).

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Estimated number of meals that can be collected by visiting this donor location. The shelter (depot) typically has zero; each donor's meals count toward the objective if visited, and each donor may be visited at most once across all volunteers.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of locations in the instance, counting the campaign office plus every voter stop; used to size the problem and iterate over all nodes.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the campaign office node. Every volunteer route must start at and return to this office.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed route length (distance or travel time) for each volunteer's round-trip from and back to the office; no volunteer's route may exceed this limit.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of volunteers available — i.e., the number of separate routes to plan, one route per volunteer.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either the office or a voter's house); used to reference which stops are visited on volunteer routes.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the map; used with the Y coordinate to compute travel distances between locations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the map; used with the X coordinate to compute travel distances between locations.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Persuasion potential (value) gained by visiting this location (voter). The objective is to maximize the sum of persuasion scores of visited locations, with each voter visited at most once.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of locations in the instance, counting every bike parking spot plus the depot (the crew garage). This is the number of nodes the solver should expect in the locations list.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the depot node where all crews begin and end their shifts. Use this id to identify the depot entry among the locations; routes must start and finish here.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed route length (in the same distance units as the coordinates/distances) for each redistribution crew. No crew's round trip may exceed this mileage limit.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of redistribution crews available (i.e., the number of separate routes to design). Each crew gets one route that starts and returns to the depot.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this bike parking spot or the depot. Matches the id used in the global depot field and in distance calculations. Each non-depot spot may be visited at most once across all crews.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the spot in the coordinate system used to compute travel distances (e.g., map projection meters or longitude). Used together with the Y coordinate to determine route distances.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the spot in the coordinate system used to compute travel distances (e.g., map projection meters or latitude). Used together with the X coordinate to determine route distances.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Congestion-relief benefit (value or score) gained when a crew services this parking spot. When a crew visits the spot its value is added to the day's total benefit. The depot typically has zero value. Each spot's value can only be collected once.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of locations considered by the planner, counting the agricultural office (depot) plus all orchards.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the agricultural office node where every inspector starts and finishes their round-trip.

global_fields.name: max_length_per_vehicle
global_fields.scenario_description: Strict maximum travel distance allowed for any inspector's round-trip; distances are measured in the same units as the location coordinates.

global_fields.name: n_vehicles
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of inspectors available; each inspector will take exactly one route that must respect the trip distance limit.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either the office or an orchard). Used to assign orchards to inspectors and to reference the depot via office_node_id.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location used to compute travel distances for inspector trips; units must match the max_trip_distance_per_inspector.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location used to compute travel distances for inspector trips; units must match the max_trip_distance_per_inspector.

item_fields.name: prize
item_fields.scenario_description: Estimated biosecurity risk reduction achieved by inspecting this orchard; the planner maximizes the sum of these values for all visited orchards (the office/depot typically has zero).
